rows.grounds: compound of forehead, syllable, mass, and situated
compound of god and worshipped in vocative

items.question: What is the prescribed action after completing one hundred thousand repetitions of the forehead-syllable mass?
premises: the forehead syllable mass is situated
one hundred thousand is to be done
items.inference: the ritual prescription is completed by worship after the count
uncertainties: exact referent of kṛtya is unclear
grammatical case of sura+arcite is uncertain
items.plain_english: Having situated the mass of syllables on the forehead and completed one hundred thousand, O worshipped god.
